Chapter 1114: 33: Incredible Improvement (Requesting Subscription)_2

Chapter 1114: Chapter 33: Incredible Improvement (Requesting Subscription)_2

“Continue.”

Lin Yuan once again began to condense the Source of Taiyin within the Taiyin Universe.

Lin Yuan knew well that the fusion of the Taiyin Universe and Fierce Sun would be his great opportunity, stemming from the thirteenth-level techniques of two different dimensional spaces.

If not for Lin Yuan, the possibility of the two touching, let alone fusing and devouring, would not exist?

In the Origin Source World, cultivators commonly have weak foundations, and most have no concept of an internal universe; even if there exists a technique like ‘Fierce Sun Opening the Sky,’ it can only be used as a personal defensive or offensive trump card.

As for using such techniques to wholly enhance one’s own foundational roots? It’s essentially unachievable.

Even if a rare few powerful individuals in the Origin Source World have developed a space akin to an internal universe, it’s merely space; without the support of the “Infinite Void,” it cannot withstand the presence of the Source of Fierce Sun.

One might say that what Lin Yuan is doing at this moment is merging the thirteenth-level techniques of two major dimensional spaces, a transformation that even a life form at the thirteenth level of time could not anticipate.

“This time, the intensity of the Source of Fierce Sun must be reduced.”

Lin Yuan began to adjust himself; the recent collapse of the Taiyin Universe and the loss of balance with the Source of Fierce Sun was mainly due to the slightly excessive illumination intensity of the Source of Fierce Sun, ultimately breaking the balance.

Having learned from the failure, Lin Yuan took a step closer to complete fusion.

Time passed day by day.

In the Chaos Void, most of Lin Yuan’s true body’s energy was focused on the fusion of the Taiyin Universe and the Source of Fierce Sun.

As the pace of fusion accelerated, the rate of improvement of the Taiyin Universe startled Lin Yuan.

The area of the Taiyin Universe expanded madly, and its inherent space-time stability soared.

No one knows how much time passed.

The Taiyin Universe and the Source of Fierce Sun finally fused completely.

To be precise.

The Source of Fierce Sun became a part of the Taiyin Universe.

The world formed by Fierce Sun Opening the Sky merged with the Taiyin Universe’s own world.

…

Star Tear Fragment World.

Lin Yuan sat facing the Taiyin Primordial Spirit.

Most of his mind gathered in the internal universe of the Taiyin Primordial Spirit.

“So unbelievable.”

Lin Yuan watched the current Taiyin Universe, where coldness and heat coexisted, and at the center of the universe, a blazing sun ceaselessly emitted infinite light and heat.

Compared to ordinary stars, this sun’s power is unknown, surpassing manyfold, and it is the core of the entire universe.

“The current Taiyin Universe has a diameter exceeding ten billion light-years…”

Lin Yuan gazed down upon the entire Taiyin Universe, his eyes slightly amazed.

In terms of size and area, the current Taiyin Universe is no smaller than the internal universe of his true body.

It’s important to know that the internal universe of Lin Yuan’s true body, even disregarding all other external factors like the infusion of Chaos Void Origin or the suppression of the Chaos Tree.

The perfect foundational Taiji Dao formed by Taiyin and Taiyang alone is far stronger than the mere Taiyin Universe.

The internal universe of his true body, to be precise, is the Taiji Universe.

“In terms of power…”

Lin Yuan felt carefully, and immediately concluded.

It is equally not weaker than the Taiji Universe of his true body.

“Merely one Source of Fierce Sun brought such a significant enhancement?”

Even Lin Yuan found it somewhat unbelievable; the disparity is equivalent to forcibly elevating a newly entering dominion-level powerhouse to the level of a Chaos Venerable.

The insurmountable gap between the Taiji Universe nurtured by his true body over many years and the internal universe formed by a single Primordial Spirit was simply erased this easily?

“With the Taiyin Universe having improved like this… if the Taiji Universe of my true body similarly devours the Source of Fierce Sun, the subsequent enhancement…”

Lin Yuan’s heartbeat quickened.

In terms of stability, the Taiji Universe far exceeds the original Taiyin Universe.

If the Taiyin Universe can devour and fuse with the Source of Fierce Sun, so can the Taiji Universe.

“No rush to try within the Taiji Universe of my true body.”

Lin Yuan’s thoughts gathered, unusually calm, intending to further experiment with the Taiyang Divine Spirit’s Taiyang Universe.

Through the fusion and devouring of the Taiyin Universe, Lin Yuan was fully aware that failures would occur, potentially causing the universe to collapse.

Compared to the collapse of the internal universes of the two great universes, the collapse of the Taiji Universe of his true body would be a much greater cost for Lin Yuan.

Without confidence, Lin Yuan would not attempt it within the Taiji Universe of his true body.

Buzz!

The next moment.

The Taiyang Divine Spirit appeared.

Lin Yuan’s consciousness directly descended into the Taiyang Universe.

Compared to the cold and icy Taiyin Universe, the Taiyang Universe presented a completely opposite scene, filled entirely with the power of the sun.

“The fusion and devouring of the Source of Fierce Sun by the Taiyin Universe were due to the opposing attributes of the two, but the Taiyang Universe?”

Lin Yuan pondered for a while and immediately began to condense the Source of Fierce Sun within the Taiyang Universe.

…

Light and heat.

The endless light and heat.

As the Taiyang Universe continually fused and devoured the Source of Fierce Sun, Lin Yuan keenly felt the changes in the Taiyang Universe.

The Taiji path that Lin Yuan walked was more perfect than the singular extreme path of Taiyin and Taiyang, but this did not mean the latter was weak.

On the contrary, a singular extreme path also could reach unimaginable heights.

For instance, the Ancestor of Fierce Sun’s Path of Fierce Sun directly stepped into the thirteenth realm; other Great Lords and Heavenly Venerables evolved their paths of strength from the chaos similarly.

Thousands of avenues, different paths lead to the same destination, with no pure strength or weakness.

Rustling sounds.

Taiyang and Fierce Sun intertwined and collided, giving rise to even hotter power.

After more than a dozen attempts, Lin Yuan’s Taiyang Divine Spirit shattered more than ten times, but finally managed to completely fuse and devour the Source of Fierce Sun.

“Now the Taiyang Universe?”

Lin Yuan steadied his mind. Even though he was prepared, at this moment, he felt the Taiyang Universe was not at all inferior to the might of the true form’s Taiji Universe.

“Fusion of Taiyin and Taiyang…”

Lin Yuan’s mind stirred slightly, and the Taiyin Primordial Spirit began to fuse with the Taiyang Divine Spirit.

Taiji is formed by the fusion of Yin and Yang; naturally, it can differentiate into Yin and Yang.

The fusion of Taiyin Primordial Spirit and Taiyang Divine Spirit would form the Taiji Primordial Spirit.

Compared to singular primordial spirits, the Taiji Primordial Spirit is stronger, not just due to singular Taiyang and Taiyin reasons, but because the fusion of the two primordial spirits also merges their powers, hence the final strength is naturally greater.

Rumbling sounds.

During the fusion of Taiyin Primordial Spirit and Taiyang Divine Spirit, the universes within naturally began to merge.

Lin Yuan watched with a solemn expression, knowing that if the fusion failed, the loss would be two primordial spirits.

Time passed.

Under Lin Yuan’s gaze.

The Taiji Primordial Spirit quickly took shape.

Buzz.

A vague sense of pressure emerged. The newly formed Taiji Primordial Spirit surprisingly exerted some pressure on Lin Yuan.

“Taiji Universe.”

Without hesitation, Lin Yuan’s consciousness descended into the Taiji Universe within the Taiji Primordial Spirit.

The universe within the true form is also a Taiji Universe, but it is much stronger than the Taiji Universe within the Taiji Primordial Spirit, given all the depth there.

“Phew!”

Gazing upon the unprecedented Taiji Universe, Lin Yuan couldn’t help but take a deep breath.

After the fusion of Taiyin Primordial Spirit and Taiyang Divine Spirit, the Taiji Universe formed was nearly nine hundred billion light-years in diameter.

In addition, the invisible pressure was pervasive throughout the universe, with a central Fierce Sun illuminating everything.

Lin Yuan stared at that Fierce Sun, as if faintly gazing at the eternal Fierce Sun in the Origin World.

Of course, it was only slightly similar, as the actual potency of the Fierce Sun within the Taiji Universe was far inferior to that eternal Fierce Sun.

“This Taiji Universe…”

Lin Yuan felt the Taiji Universe piece by piece, “is much stronger than the Taiji Universe of the true form.”

As for exactly how much stronger, Lin Yuan couldn’t determine, without a specific point of reference, couldn’t exactly let the two Taiji Universes clash, could he?

…

Deep within the true form’s universe.

Beside the jade gourd, the red-clothed girl lazily crossed her legs.

“The master must be disappointed; only a ten-centimeter mark was left on the Eternal Metal.”

The red-clothed girl could detect Lin Yuan’s slight disappointment at that time.

“I need to find time to reassure the master; it’s Eternal Metal, leaving a ten-centimeter mark is already quite impressive.”

The red-clothed girl thought to herself.

Just then, Lin Yuan appeared beside her.

“Master.”

The red-clothed girl immediately jumped up.

“Where is that Eternal Metal?” Lin Yuan asked with a smile, looking at the red-clothed girl.

“Eternal Metal?” The red-clothed girl was slightly puzzled: “What does the master want to do with Eternal Metal?”

“I plan to attempt it again.” Lin Yuan said.

With those words.

The red-clothed girl blinked.

Attempt it again?

Does the master feel he didn’t exert his full strength before?

“Master, you are already very impressive, being able to leave a ten-centimeter mark on the Eternal Metal.”

The red-clothed girl couldn’t help but speak; the advancement of the universe within isn’t an overnight task.

The red-clothed girl hadn’t even felt how long Lin Yuan continued to cultivate the “Infinite Void” second level.

At this time, trying the Eternal Metal again, doesn’t have much meaning, perhaps just leaving another ten-centimeter mark?
